subject: Data Engineering
title: Choosing OLTP or OLAP
description: A fast breakdown of Choosing OLTP or OLAP for builders.

hook.text: An engineer asks: 'Should I use Postgres or Snowflake?' The real question is: what's the workload?

buildup.text: If the workload is many small reads and writes — like an app backend — choose OLTP.

discovery.text: If the workload is few complex queries scanning large datasets — like a dashboard — choose OLAP.

twist.text: Using OLAP for transactions is slow. Using OLTP for analytics is expensive. Both are common mistakes.

climax.text: Most architectures use both: OLTP for the app, OLAP for the warehouse, and a pipeline connecting them.

punchline.text: Match the engine to the workload. Never the reverse.

quiz.question: When should you choose an OLAP system over OLTP?
options: When the workload involves complex queries on large datasets
When you need fast single-record writes
When building a mobile app backend
